builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Shuriken Flip E2 within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E2 at rank5 is 0.7*(350+1.0 total AD+1.1 AP) magic damage; AP and MR penetration strengthen the return hit. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya/Banshee add105AP each without mana. Riftmaker converts bonusHP toAP and adds8% damage at full ramp. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR; Shadowflame amplifies eligible low-health magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. E mark active; only E2 collision. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet.

Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

kitEvidence.formula: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing [(70 / 140 / 210 / 280 / 350 + (1) × AD + (1.1) × AP) × (0.3)] magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing [(70 / 140 / 210 / 280 / 350 + (1) × AD + (1.1) × AP) × (0.7)] magic damage.
